training.checkpoint_selection: lowest validation loss; never test rejections
training.reuse_trained_weights: inventory and current-class loading required; no retraining or compatibility aliases to repair old artifacts

data_availability: Configured candidates in yaml_configs/configs.yaml; raw snapshots, versions, independent unit IDs and trained checkpoint manifests still required. No downloads/training have run.

observation.windows: Choose units and horizon from training only; same fixed horizon for every test in a cell
prohibited: selecting trajectories because enough future events exist
assuming a fixed event-budget tail is empty

capability_gates.all: No excluded failed trials; stop and diagnose unsupported model/observation/test combinations
capability_gates.mmd: Same frozen trained generator, identical observations, explicit horizon, complete pooled Gram
capability_gates.relative_loss: Causal restricted mean including time zero and terminal origin
capability_gates.ksd: Complete likelihood/insertion ratio, all later intensities recomputed, deterministic converged quadrature, all marks, state budget
capability_gates.neural_initial_law: NHP empty-history tested. THP/SAHP/RMTPP tested with a fixed real conditioning history; unconditional KSD/loss marked unsupported, no fictitious BOS. Per-row distinct-history evaluation is not yet supported by the new reference adapter.

blocks.name: oracle_size
blocks.purpose: Calibration with known Poisson/Hawkes models and matching complete observation; no hidden burn mismatch

blocks.name: trained_model_size
blocks.purpose: Independent draws from exactly the same frozen trained model; report conditional calibration by training seed

blocks.name: controlled_power
blocks.purpose: Fresh held-out synthetic alternatives: rate, excitation, p3, timing dependence, mark law, time/mark dependence, equal-relative-loss counterexample

blocks.name: real_model_criticism
blocks.purpose: Frozen model vs held-out real data; report adequacy rejections, prediction errors and diagnostics, not Type I error or known power

statistics.intervals: Exact binomial95 for independent Monte Carlo draws per fixed training seed
statistics.calibration: Predeclare family before execution and Bonferroni excess threshold0.01/family_size
statistics.paired_power: Same observations and simulations across methods; exact McNemar and Holm over all declared comparisons
statistics.real_resampling: Repeated reuse of one real dataset describes stability only, not independent binomial power
statistics.training_uncertainty: Report every seed and stratify; no claim from only three trained models about general training uncertainty

outputs: raw statistic and all null vectors
